row.evidence: Buffer's pricing page lists Free, Essentials ($5/month per channel) and Team ($10/month per channel) with 2FA and API keys but no SSO or SCIM, and the help centre and API docs never mention SAML, SSO or SCIM.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: no SCIM or SAML SSO at any tier (none by absence). Pricing is per connected channel, not per user: Essentials $5/mo and Team $10/mo per channel billed yearly; Team adds unlimited users, access levels and approvals, and adding users requires Team. Team members are invited manually; the public GraphQL API (all plans) covers posts, ideas, channels and tags, not users. Okta's catalogue lists Buffer as an SWA (password vaulting) app only.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 user. The API is available but has no user-management functions.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Per-channel pricing; unlimited team members, access levels, approval workflows.

scim.notes: No SCIM mentioned anywhere on the pricing page, help-centre sitemap or developer docs; Buffer never states 'no' explicitly.

rate_limits.text: Per key: 100 requests per 15 minutes; 250 (Free, Essentials) or 500 (Team) per 24 hours; 3,000 / 7,500 / 15,000 per 30 days.

limitations.text: The public GraphQL API (all plans) is limited to posts, ideas, channels, organizations and tags; the data model has no users or team members.

user_api.notes: A general-purpose API exists on every plan, but it does not manage users, so user_api.available is false.

okta.notes: Only SWA is checked on the OIN page (read from page markup).

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial found (buffer-tutorial returns 404).

fallbacks.other_sync: Manual invites only: owners and admins invite users by email from Settings > Team (Team plan).
